title: The Canonical Parallel Form as a Substrate for Parallelizing Compilers and Agentic Optimizers
summary: Imperative code fixes an execution order the computation does not require, and a parallelizing compiler must prove which parts of that order it can remove. We introduce the Canonical Parallel Form (CPF), a device-neutral program state from which every ordering constraint our analyses prove unnecessary has been removed.
